A reading at the soft end, near 0.16% to 0.18%, would support New York Fed President Williams’ view that price pressures are shock-driven and could trim expectations for tightening beyond this year. The weak yen is the key amplifier: with oil prices elevated by the Iran war, every leg lower in the currency raises the yen cost of energy and feeds back into pipeline inflation.
